title: Ground Chicken and Kidney Bean Minestrone
intro: A satisfying lunch or quick weeknight dinner, this one-pot soup brings Italian-inspired comfort without heavy meats. Lean chicken and fiber-rich kidney beans help stabilize afternoon energy levels.

ingredients.name: Low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.canonical_name: Soup, chicken broth, low sodium, canned

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned diced tomatoes
ingredients.canonical_name: Tomatoes, red, ripe, canned, packed in tomato juice, no salt added

ingredients.name: No-salt-added canned dark red kidney beans
ingredients.canonical_name: Beans, kidney, all types, mature seeds, canned, no salt added

ingredients.name: Frozen chopped spinach
ingredients.canonical_name: Spinach, frozen, chopped or leaf, unprepared

instructions: Heat olive oil in a medium pot over medium-high heat.
Add chopped onion, minced garlic, and ground chicken, and cook for 5 to 6 minutes while breaking the meat apart with a wooden spoon until browned.
Stir in Italian seasoning, chicken broth, diced tomatoes, kidney beans, and pasta.
Bring the soup to a boil, then reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 9 to 11 minutes, checking the pasta for tenderness at 9 minutes.
Stir in frozen spinach and simmer for 2 more minutes until wilted and heated through.
variation: Swap the spinach for chopped kale or the chicken for turkey.
conservation: Keeps 3 days refrigerated; reheat gently on the stovetop.

[taste_coherence] The Italian flavor profile is classic and well-conceived, but because the recipe relies strictly on no-salt-added canned goods, low-sodium broth, and zero added salt, it may taste noticeably flat. The computed sodium is only 155 mg per serving. Suggest adding 1/4 tsp kosher salt to step 3; this will enhance the flavors while keeping the sodium (~300 mg per serving) safely under the 500 mg ceiling.

[cooking_method_suitability] In step 2, adding minced garlic at the exact same time as raw chicken and onions over medium-high heat for 5-6 minutes risks scorching the garlic before the chicken finishes cooking. Fix: Add the minced garlic during the final 1 minute of browning.
